remarks: Here is YOUR opportunity to join this robust community. Conveniently located in the heart of downtown Stamford! Each room in this 2 bedroom unit is oversized and offers ample room to stretch out. Primary bedroom offers a wall of closets and is huge! The 2nd bedroom is a good size and has a large closet. Updated full bathroom with tub/shower combination. There are SO many closets in this unit you will run out of things to put in them! The open Living Room/Dining Room allows for flexible entertaining. Large deck directly off the living room offers an outdoor space to relax, get some fresh air and offers a view of the city! Convenient to downtown Stamford and public transportation. Pool, exercise room, laundry room and 24 gated security service and more. Fully paid assessment for new, modernized elevators. Make YOUR move!
